## Specific task description

Task instruction: Pick the orange capped bottle and set it on the pad

Task description: Move the white medicine bottle with an orange cap on the left side of the table to the blue square mat in front and to its right.

Success criteria: The bottle is horizontally near the center of the blue square mat and has been set down on it, not merely suspended above it. Both grippers are open.

## Execution tips

- Consider grasping the bottle around its middle below the shoulder, with the pads contacting opposite sides and enough clearance between the fingertips and table. This avoids catching only the cap edge or having the fingertips hit the table first during placement.
- Set the gripper opening slightly wider than the selected grasp section. Before closing, confirm both fingers are actually on opposite sides of the bottle rather than squeezing from one side and pushing it over.
- During movement, keep the cap facing up and the bottle base clear of the table. Leave the gray box behind the bottle and the shoe to the right of the mat clear of the grippers to reduce dragging and tipping.
- Slow the descent near the mat, confirm the bottle base is supported before releasing, and leave space between the fingers and bottle during withdrawal to avoid releasing it while suspended or tipping it over.
